Strategy: Reward the good band and penalize both sides of it, punishing near-exact leftovers below five and mid-loose leftovers between forty-six and sixty. It may help by fencing the band in on both sides, but may fail if the penalties hit bins that are actually useful.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 46 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
